remarks: Experience the perfect blend of luxury and convenience in this beautifully appointed townhouse offering resort-like amenities and effortless, low-maintenance living. The open and airy layout showcases high-end finishes throughout, with an elevator providing easy access to all three levels. The location is ideal being on quiet cul de sac with private backyard. The current owners have added thoughtful upgrades including a 24 kw whole-house generator, professionally designed home gym, California Custom closets, elegant wool stair runners, and an expanded blue stone terrace ideal for outdoor entertaining or relaxation. Their attention and level of care in maintaining this home is unparalleled. Set within a sought-after community with exceptional amenities, this home delivers an exceptional lifestyle-refined, worry-free, and ready to enjoy.
